description_en: Queries the list of jobs under a specified task or a specified device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定任务或指定设备下的作业列表
name: ListTask

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的记录数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The task ID. The globally unique identifier of the task.

If the Device parameter is specified, do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。任务的全局唯一标识符。

如果传入Device参数，此参数不传
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next page. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. If a next page exists, the service returns a NextToken value. Specify this value in the next request.

The NextToken value is valid for 1 minute. After it expires, the corresponding error code is returned
parameters.help_zh:
下一页标识。首次查询可不传入值。如果存在下一页，服务会返回NextToken值，下次请求时传入。

NextToken值有效时间为1分钟。失效后，将返回对应的错误码
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The device information. For more information, see the "Device definition" section below.

If the JobId parameter is specified, do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
设备信息。更多信息，请参见下文“Device定义”。

如果传入JobId参数，此参数不传
parameters.name: device

parameters.help_en:
The status of the job under the task. Valid values:

QUEUED: pending scheduling.
SENT: scheduled.
IN_PROGRESS: running.
FAILED: failed.
REJECTED: rejected.
TIMED_OUT: timed out.
SUCCEEDED: succeeded.
CANCELLED: canceled
parameters.help_zh:
任务作业的状态。取值范围：

QUEUED：待调度。
SENT：已调度。
IN_PROGRESS：执行中。
FAILED：失败。
REJECTED：已拒绝。
TIMED_OUT：已超时。
SUCCEEDED：已成功。
CANCELLED：已取消
parameters.name: status

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next page. If a next page exists, the service returns a NextToken value. Specify this value in the next request.

The NextToken value is valid for 1 minute. After it expires, the corresponding error code is returned
NextToken.description_zh:
下一页标识。如果存在下一页，服务会返回NextToken值，下次请求时传入。

NextToken值有效时间为1分钟。失效后，将返回对应的错误码

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
